title: Pet Registration-Year Fee Posting — Community Rules & Site Care Resident Desk
content:
Under Community Rules & Site Care, a registration-year fee is charged for each registered pet for each calendar registration year, dated the registration date in the pet's first year and January 1 in later years, and carrying the pet's name as registered and the year it covers. The resident desk posts the fee to the plan record's rules and site-care statement.

## What the posting does

`post_pet_registration_fee_a0279ba6` adds one pet registration fee charge, for one named pet and one calendar registration year, to the statement of the named plan record and raises the record's statement balance by that amount. The resident sees the fee, with the pet's name and the year it covers, on their rules and site-care statement.

## How it is invoked

It is an agent-side tool: the representative first unlocks `post_pet_registration_fee_a0279ba6` and then calls it on the resident desk's behalf. One call posts the fee of one pet for one registration year.

## Parameters

- **`rules_plan_id`** — the reference number of the site-care plan record whose statement is charged, as returned by the site-care plan record lookup for the resident. Identifier.
- **`pet_name`** — the pet's name exactly as it is registered, copied character for character from the pet name shown on the pet's earlier registration fees on the statement, keeping spelling, capitals and punctuation, with no translation, normalisation, abbreviation, addition or deletion.
- **`registration_year`** — the calendar year the registration covers, a four-digit integer year (YYYY), for example 2026.
- **`entry_date`** — the charge date shown on the statement for the fee, YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time of day and no time zone.
- **`amount`** — the registration fee in US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); any further digits are rounded half up to the cent.

## Return

A successful call returns a receipt with status `posted`, showing the statement reference of the new fee, the plan record charged, the pet's name as registered, the registration year, the charge date, the amount, and the statement balance once the fee is on it. The tool defines no other outcome.

## Contract questions

**Does the name have to match the earlier fees exactly?** Yes: the name is copied verbatim from the pet's earlier registration fees on the statement.

**Can two pets share one posting?** No; each call carries one pet and one registration year.
